title: Make Django settings environment-driven
description: Scaffold settings hardcode SECRET_KEY, DEBUG=True, ALLOWED_HOSTS=[] and sqlite. Production deploy is impossible until settings read from env. Add django-environ, .env.sample, Postgres via DATABASE_URL, and wire DRF/CORS/spectacular into INSTALLED_APPS (DRF is installed but unregistered).
acceptance_criteria: No secrets in source; DEBUG defaults False; DATABASE_URL drives Postgres; .env.sample documents every var

title: Configure git remote and beads Dolt sync
description: No git remote exists. Create nycmeshnet/inventory-tng, add origin, then 'bd dolt remote add origin <url>' and 'bd dolt push' so beads issues sync off this machine. Beads warns on every write until this is done.

title: DESIGN: QR multi-scan batch transaction flow
description: KEY FEATURE. Current system supports one QR scan per item; the replacement MUST retain QR scanning AND add scanning multiple codes into a single transaction (cart/batch model). Decide browser camera scanning library vs keyboard-wedge hardware scanners; design the batch API.

title: DESIGN: inventory data model
description: Model Item/Asset, Location, Category, Transaction/Movement, and audit history. Must cover everything the current Google Sheet (15k+ rows) tracks. Consider django-simple-history for audit trail, as MeshDB uses.

title: Write CONTRIBUTING.md volunteer on-ramp
description: NYC Mesh is a volunteer community; lowering barrier to entry is a primary goal. Clear path from zero to running app to first PR, explicitly usable without AI agents.

title: Write docs/deployment.md
description: Canonical deploy doc covering the shared Dockerfile+Helm artifact set for standard k8s (k3s on Proxmox) and CodeNOW (nycmesh.codenow.com). Env var matrix, migrations, superuser, static files.

title: Add CI workflows and PR/issue templates
description: GitHub Actions: backend lint+test, frontend lint+build, docker build, and a markdown link checker that enforces the doc single-source-of-truth linking. PR template carries the mandatory docs-updated checkbox.

title: Write docs/architecture.md
description: Canonical architecture doc: monorepo rationale, backend/frontend/DB choices, how it mirrors MeshDB and where it deliberately diverges, planned Celery/QR pieces. Single source of truth - all other docs link here.

title: Scaffold Vite + React 19 + MUI frontend
description: frontend/ with Vite, React 19, TypeScript, MUI 9, eslint+prettier, vitest. Builds to static assets served by nginx - no Node runtime in production.

title: Add Helm chart at infra/helm/inventory-tng
description: Single chart deploying backend (gunicorn) + frontend (nginx) + service/ingress/config. Serves BOTH standard k8s and CodeNOW - per docs.codenow.com custom stacks, CodeNOW consumes your own Dockerfile + Helm chart, so there is no second deploy path.

title: Add compose.yaml and devcontainer for local dev
description: Postgres 18 + backend + frontend for one-command local startup. Devcontainer so volunteers can start with zero host setup.

title: Restructure backend to src/ layout mirroring MeshDB
description: Move backend/inventory_tng/{manage.py,inventory_tng,quickstart} to backend/src/{manage.py,inventory_tng,inventory}. Mirrors MeshDB (src/meshdb project pkg + src/meshapi domain app). Drop the empty scaffolded quickstart app.
acceptance_criteria: manage.py check passes from new location; no stale imports

title: Rebuild AGENTS.md as a thin router (<40 lines)
description: Collapse the ~4x duplicated beads content (hand-written preamble + BEADS INTEGRATION block + BEADS CODEX SETUP block + hook-injected bd prime output) into one pointer. Keep only universally-required context: orientation, doc pointers, bd pointer, conservative git policy, non-interactive shell flags, quality gate, skill index. Do not hand-edit inside beads managed markers.

title: Add backend dependency manifest (pyproject.toml + uv.lock)
description: backend/ has a uv-created .venv but no pyproject.toml or requirements.txt, so setup is unreproducible and a Dockerfile has nothing to install from. Pin the four installed packages (django 6.0.5, djangorestframework 3.17.1, asgiref 3.11.1, sqlparse 0.5.5) and requires-python >=3.14.

title: Migrate data from the Google Sheets inventory
description: Import 15k+ rows from the existing Google Forms/Sheets system. Consider django-import-export, as MeshDB uses for spreadsheet interchange.

title: Add LICENSE
description: MeshDB carries a LICENSE file. Pick a license consistent with NYC Mesh practice and add it before the repo goes public.

title: Integrate GitHub issues with beads
description: Volunteers work in GitHub issues; agents work in beads. Wire bd config github.org/github.repo so agents are aware of GitHub issues and can open them. Requires the nycmeshnet/inventory-tng remote to exist.

title: Add ADRs for deliberate divergences from MeshDB
description: docs/decisions/: monorepo choice, Vite SPA over meshforms (bitrotted: Next 14/React 18/MUI 5/TS 5.3 vs current 16/19/9/7, plus direct-to-Postgres client), ruff over black+isort+flake8, psycopg3 over psycopg2, Django 6.1 over 5.2 LTS.

title: Symlink CLAUDE.md, CODEX.md, GEMINI.md to AGENTS.md
description: Replace standalone CLAUDE.md with a symlink; add CODEX.md and GEMINI.md symlinks. Resolves the beads warning about AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md not sharing an inode.

title: Write DEVELOPERS.md for contributor setup and workflow
description: Toolchain (mise/uv/python 3.14), first-time setup, devcontainer workflow, repo layout including the backend/inventory_tng nesting gotcha, common tasks (deps, migrations, tests, new apps), bd pointer, branch/commit conventions.

title: Factor specialised agent context into .agents/skills/
description: Create django-backend and deploy skills so Django and deploy specifics load on demand rather than sitting in always-loaded context. Symlink .claude/skills -> ../.agents/skills for Claude Code discovery; verify Claude follows a symlinked skills dir.

title: Add Docker + devcontainer infra for backend
description: Create backend/Dockerfile, .dockerignore, compose.yaml and .devcontainer/devcontainer.json so README deploy instructions and DEVELOPERS setup describe something real. mise.toml already pulls devcontainer-cli.

title: Write README.md with usage and deploy instructions
description: User-and-operator facing doc: what inventory-tng is, prerequisites, quickstart, and deployment via the container image (env vars, migrations, serving, collectstatic).

title: Plan Django 6.1 -> 6.2 LTS upgrade before April 2027
description: Django 6.1 is a regular release with roughly a 16-month support window (chosen over 5.2 LTS deliberately). Django 6.2 is expected to be the next LTS in April 2027; schedule the upgrade rather than discovering it at EOL.
